forms.source_quote: Application for Work Permit made Outside of Canada (IMM 1295)
forms.reason: Edition not printed in the official inputs; the 06-2018 edition appears only in an untrusted draft. Accompanying family members file their own application forms (see rule), but the sources do not say which form each family member uses.

forms.title: Document Checklist for a Work Permit (Applied Outside Canada)
forms.source_quote: This document checklist is one of the forms that you need to submit with your application.

forms.title: New Delhi Visa Office Additional Document Checklist - Work Permit
forms.source_quote: This additional document checklist is one of the forms that you need to submit with your application,
forms.reason: Always needed only within this New Delhi combination. Which countries the New Delhi office serves is not in the inputs (see unresolved).

forms.title: Family Information
forms.condition_plain: Needed for each applicant aged 18 or older at the application date, and for a minor who is travelling alone to Canada.
forms.source_quote: Family Information (IMM 5707)Note: Must be completed by those aged 18 years or older or a minor travelling alone to Canada.
forms.reason: The New Delhi checklist asks for IMM 5707 without stating the age condition. Both readings are kept in an uncertain rule. Edition not printed in the official inputs.

forms.title: Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union
forms.condition_plain: Needed once per couple when the principal applicant has a common-law partner who will accompany them to Canada.
forms.source_quote: If you are in a common-law relationship and your common-law partner will accompany you to Canada, you must fill out and click on the “Validate” button located at the end of the form Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union (IMM 5409)
forms.reason: The IMM 5488 entry says 'if applicable' and refers to the visa office; the New Delhi checklist is silent. The value 'common_law' is a placeholder: the marital status code differs between form code lists, and the specialist must confirm the canonical value.

forms.title: Use of a Representative
forms.condition_plain: Needed when the applicant uses an authorized representative, or is appointing, updating or cancelling a representative.
forms.source_quote: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476), if applicableNote: Complete this form only if you are using the services of an authorized representative, or if you are appointing or cancelling a representative.
forms.reason: Adult dependent children need their own copy (see rule).

forms.title: Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual
forms.condition_plain: Needed only when the applicant authorizes IRCC and CBSA to release case information to someone other than themselves.
forms.source_quote: Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (IMM 5475), if applicableNote: Complete this form only if you authorize Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) and the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) to release information from your case file to someone other than yourself.

forms.title: Schedule 1 - Application for Temporary Resident Visa
forms.condition_plain: Needed for an applicant who answered yes to any background information question on the application form.
forms.source_quote: If you have answered “yes” to any of the background information questions on the application
forms.reason: Condition is incomplete. IMM 1295 question 2c has no identified wording or field, and the ill-treatment question uses a proposed field. Whether the medical questions count as 'background information' is uncertain (see rule).

forms.title: Offer of employment form (employer form)
forms.source_quote: provide a copy of the IMM 5802 and proof that the employer compliance fee has been paid.
forms.reason: This form is completed by the employer, not the applicant. The applicant only supplies a copy, which is handled as a document requirement line.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of fee payment (processing fee and other applicable fees receipt)
document_requirements.source_quote: Proof of payment showing the amount paid.
document_requirements.reason: Guide 5487 allows family members applying together to use one payment receipt for the total amount.

document_requirements.document_type: Evidence of exemption from the work permit processing fee
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an applicant who is exempt from paying the work permit processing fee.
document_requirements.source_quote: Note: If you are exempt from paying the work permit processing fee, you must submit documents proving so.

document_requirements.document_type: Passport or travel document information page photocopy
document_requirements.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.

document_requirements.document_type: Visa application photographs
document_requirements.condition_plain: Paper photos only when the applicant is not required to give biometric fingerprints and photo.
document_requirements.source_quote: Two photos meeting the requirements of the Visa application photograph specifications.
document_requirements.reason: The IRCC web page says 1 photo while the checklist and guide say two; see the uncertain rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of legal immigration status in country of residence
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only when the applicant's country or territory of residence differs from the citizenship on their passport.
document_requirements.source_quote: Proof of current immigration status: If your country or territory of residence differs from the citizenship listed on your passport, you must provide proof of legal status in your country or territory of residence.
document_requirements.reason: Guide 5487 words the trigger as the country where applying instead of the country of residence; see the uncertain rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Marriage certificate or licence (photocopy)
document_requirements.condition_plain: Drafted from 'if applicable': the principal applicant is married and the spouse accompanies them to Canada.
document_requirements.source_quote: Photocopy of your Marriage license or Certificate, if applicableNote: Refer to the responsible visa office for your region.
document_requirements.reason: The New Delhi checklist also lists it 'as applicable'. Whether it applies to every married applicant or only when the spouse accompanies is uncertain (see rule). The value 'married' is a placeholder for the canonical code.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of meeting the requirements of the offered job
document_requirements.condition_plain: When the application is for an employer-specific work permit (there is a job being offered).
document_requirements.source_quote: Proof indicating you meet the requirements of the job being offered.
document_requirements.reason: The checklist lists this without a condition, but the IRCC page says open work permit applicants upload 'Not applicable' for employment documents. The specialist should confirm.

document_requirements.document_type: Copy of LMIA and copy of employment contract from prospective employer
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only when the employer obtained an LMIA from ESDC for the job.
document_requirements.source_quote: If your employer obtained a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) from Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), provide a copy of the LMIA AND a copy of your employment contract from your prospective employer.
document_requirements.reason: The IRCC page also mentions the LMIA file number for LMIA-required jobs.

document_requirements.document_type: Copy of IMM 5802 offer of employment and proof of employer compliance fee payment
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only when IRCC authorized the employer to submit the offer of employment using the IMM 5802 form.
document_requirements.source_quote: If IRCC authorized your employer to submit the offer of employment using the IMM 5802 form, provide a copy of the IMM 5802 and proof that the employer compliance fee has been paid.
document_requirements.reason: The other parts of IMM 5488 entry 8 (offer of employment number; contract when the employer is exempt from the compliance regime) are drafted as rules.

document_requirements.document_type: Québec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) evidence
document_requirements.condition_plain: When the intended work is in Québec and the job has an LMIA.
document_requirements.source_quote: If working in the province of Québec with an LMIA, provide evidence of a valid Québec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) issued by the Québec Ministère de l’Immigration, de la Francisation et de l’Intégration (MIFI).
document_requirements.reason: The IRCC page adds 'paid job in Quebec for more than 30 days'; see the uncertain rule. The province code value 'QC' must be confirmed against the canonical code list.

document_requirements.document_type: Provincial/territorial confirmation of nomination and R204(c) letter
document_requirements.condition_plain: When the applicant is a provincial nominee with an LMIA-exempt offer of employment from an employer in the nominating province or territory.
document_requirements.source_quote: If you are a Provincial Nominee and have an offer of employment to a Foreign National exempt from an LMIA (either a form [IMM 5802] or the offer of employment ID number) from an employer in the province or territory that nominated you, provide a copy of the confirmation of nomination issued by the province or territory that nominated you and a R204c) letter issued by the province or territory.
document_requirements.reason: The expired-nomination acknowledgment letter is drafted as a separate rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of completion of program of study (final transcript, or institution letter / formal notice of graduation)
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only when applying for a post-graduation work permit.
document_requirements.source_quote: If applying for a post-graduation work permit, submit proof that you have completed all the requirements of your program of study:a final transcript; ora letter from the institution or the formal notice of graduation.
document_requirements.reason: The language proficiency proof in the same entry is drafted as a rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Additional documents required by the responsible visa office
document_requirements.source_quote: Any additional documents required by the responsible visa office.
document_requirements.reason: This is a referral, not a document. In this combination it is answered by the New Delhi IMM 5905 lines. Any further requests are covered by the officer tasks.

document_requirements.document_type: Education and work experience evidence (New Delhi specification: certificates, diplomas or degrees with mark sheets; appointment and relieving letters; salary slips and Form 16; bank statements; reference letters with duration, duties and contact details)
document_requirements.condition_plain: When there is a job offered (employer-specific work permit).
document_requirements.source_quote: You must submit evidence that you meet the requirements of the job offered:
document_requirements.reason: The New Delhi checklist states no condition, but it refers to 'the job offered'. This overlaps the IMM 5488 entry 6 line and the IRCC-page employment lines; the reviewer may merge them.

document_requirements.document_type: IMM 5257 Schedule 1 (form)
document_requirements.source_quote: Schedule 1:
document_requirements.reason: This is a form, not a supporting document. It is handled in the forms list and the Schedule 1 rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Birth certificate of accompanying dependent child
document_requirements.condition_plain: For each dependent child who will accompany the principal applicant to Canada.
document_requirements.source_quote: You must provide children’s birth certificates for accompanying dependents.

document_requirements.document_type: Marriage certificate (New Delhi entry)
document_requirements.source_quote: Marriage Certificate, as applicable.
document_requirements.reason: Same document as the IMM 5488 entry 5 marriage certificate line. It is kept there to avoid a double requirement; this entry confirms it.

document_requirements.document_type: IMM 5707 Family Information (form)
document_requirements.source_quote: You must provide the Family Information Form (IMM 5707) fully completed, signed and dated.
document_requirements.reason: This is a form. It is handled in the forms list and the uncertain IMM 5707 rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Certified translation of documents not in English or French
document_requirements.condition_plain: For each submitted document that is not in English or French.
document_requirements.source_quote: If your documents are in a language other than English or French, you must include a certified
document_requirements.reason: IMM 5488 defers translation to the visa office; New Delhi requires certified translation.

document_requirements.document_type: Translator's affidavit
document_requirements.condition_plain: For a translated document whose translator is not a Canadian certified translator.
document_requirements.source_quote: If the translation isn’t done by a Canadian certified translator, the person who completed the translation must provide an affidavit swearing to their language proficiency and the accuracy of the translation.
document_requirements.reason: New Delhi requires a 'certified translation', which may exclude the non-certified-translator route; see the uncertain rule.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of common-law relationship (evidence listed on IMM 5409)
document_requirements.condition_plain: When the principal applicant's common-law partner will accompany them to Canada.
document_requirements.source_quote: send proof listed on the form to support your relationship.
document_requirements.reason: The value 'common_law' is a placeholder for the canonical marital status code.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of completed upfront medical exam
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an applicant who had an upfront medical exam with a panel physician.
document_requirements.source_quote: If you have an upfront medical exam, you must submit proof that you completed the medical exam with your application.
document_requirements.reason: Whether a medical exam is needed at all is left to a task, because the country list is not in the inputs.

document_requirements.document_type: Letter of explanation - Venezuelan passport extended 5 years
document_requirements.condition_plain: Venezuelan passport issued before 7 June 2019, whose printed expiry date has passed, and that has been expired for less than 5 years at the application date.
document_requirements.source_quote: Include a letter of explanation with your application stating: “I am a Venezuelan national with a Venezuelan passport, which has been extended for 5 years past the printed expiry date.”
document_requirements.reason: The country value 'Venezuela' must be mapped to the canonical country code.

document_requirements.document_type: Letter of explanation - exceptional situation, no valid travel document (Venezuelan passport)
document_requirements.condition_plain: Venezuelan passport issued before 7 June 2019, expired for 5 years or more, where the applicant has an exceptional situation and cannot get a new passport or other acceptable travel document.
document_requirements.source_quote: Include a letter of explanation with details of your exceptional situation and why you can’t get a valid travel document.
document_requirements.reason: Under its heading, the guide says both 'expired for 5 years or more' and 'more than 5 years'. The specialist must confirm the boundary. The officer's decision is a separate task.

document_requirements.document_type: Letter from current employer
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an employer-specific work permit.
document_requirements.source_quote: a letter from your current employer

document_requirements.document_type: Reference letter from past employers
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an employer-specific work permit.
document_requirements.source_quote: a reference letter from past employers
document_requirements.reason: Overlaps the New Delhi reference-letter requirement; the reviewer may merge.

document_requirements.document_type: Proof of past work experience (e.g. pay stubs)
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an employer-specific work permit.
document_requirements.source_quote: proof of past work experience (for example, pay stubs)
document_requirements.reason: Overlaps the New Delhi work-experience evidence; the reviewer may merge.

document_requirements.document_type: Résumé
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only for an employer-specific work permit.
document_requirements.source_quote: a résumé

document_requirements.document_type: Job offer letter
document_requirements.condition_plain: Only when the job requires an LMIA.
document_requirements.source_quote: a job offer letter

document_requirements.document_type: Employment contract (LMIA-exempt job)
document_requirements.condition_plain: When the job is LMIA-exempt.
document_requirements.source_quote: If your job is LMIA-exempt, your employer must give you:
document_requirements.reason: The IRCC page lists a contract for every LMIA-exempt job. IMM 5488 asks for it only when the employer is exempt from the Employer Compliance Regime. See the uncertain rule.

document_requirements.document_type: No document - TRV/eTA issued with work permit
document_requirements.source_quote: If you need a TRV or an eTA, you do not have to fill out a separate application or pay more fees.
document_requirements.reason: Informational. It adds no form or document.

document_requirements.document_type: No document - PGWP application window
document_requirements.source_quote: You have up to 180 days after you receive confirmation from your school that you have completed
document_requirements.reason: This is an eligibility and timing statement, not a document requirement. The configuration must not state eligibility.

document_requirements.document_type: No document - false statements warning
document_requirements.source_quote: False statements or submission of fraudulent documents will result in immediate refusal and possible
document_requirements.reason: A warning, not a requirement.

rules.then: Add form IMM 5707 Family Information for this person.
rules.why_shown: The checklist requires the family information form from everyone aged 18 or older and from minors travelling alone.
rules.source_quote: Family Information (IMM 5707)Note: Must be completed by those aged 18 years or older or a minor travelling alone to Canada.
rules.when_plain: The person is 18 or older at the application date, or is a minor travelling alone to Canada.

rules.then: Decide whether New Delhi requires IMM 5707 from every applicant or only under the IMM 5488 age condition.
rules.why_shown: The New Delhi checklist asks for IMM 5707 without an age condition.
readings: New Delhi requires IMM 5707 from every applicant, including accompanying minors, regardless of age.
The New Delhi line restates the general requirement and the IMM 5488 condition (18+ or minor travelling alone) still applies.
rules.source_quote: You must provide the Family Information Form (IMM 5707) fully completed, signed and dated.
rules.when_plain: Applies to every applicant in this combination.

rules.then: Add form IMM 5409 (once per couple) and the supporting common-law evidence document line.
rules.why_shown: An accompanying common-law partner must be supported by the statutory declaration and evidence.
rules.source_quote: If you are in a common-law relationship and your common-law partner will accompany you to Canada, you must fill out and click on the “Validate” button located at the end of the form Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union (IMM 5409)
rules.when_plain: The principal applicant is in a common-law relationship and the partner will accompany them to Canada.

rules.then: Add form IMM 5476 Use of a Representative.
rules.why_shown: The form is required when a representative acts on the file, or when one is appointed or cancelled.
rules.source_quote: Use of a Representative (IMM 5476), if applicableNote: Complete this form only if you are using the services of an authorized representative, or if you are appointing or cancelling a representative.
rules.when_plain: A representative is used, or a representative is being appointed, updated or cancelled.

rules.then: Add a separate IMM 5476 for this dependent child.
rules.why_shown: Adult dependent children must sign their own representative form if the representative also acts for them.
rules.source_quote: If you have dependent children aged 18 years or older, they must fill out their own copy of this form if a representative is also conducting business on their behalf.
rules.when_plain: The dependent child is 18 or older at the application date and the representative also conducts business on their behalf.

rules.then: Add form IMM 5475.
rules.why_shown: Required only if the applicant wants IRCC/CBSA to share case information with someone else.
rules.source_quote: Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (IMM 5475), if applicableNote: Complete this form only if you authorize Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) and the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) to release information from your case file to someone other than yourself.
rules.when_plain: The applicant authorizes release of case information to a designated individual.

rules.then: Add form IMM 5257 Schedule 1 for this applicant.
rules.why_shown: New Delhi requires Schedule 1 when any background question on the application form is answered yes.
rules.source_quote: If you have answered “yes” to any of the background information questions on the application
rules.when_plain: Any background information question on the applicant's IMM 1295 is answered yes (question 2c is not yet covered; see unresolved).

rules.then: Specialist to decide which IMM 1295 questions count as 'background information questions' for the Schedule 1 trigger.
rules.why_shown: The scope of the Schedule 1 trigger is not defined in the New Delhi checklist.
readings: Every question in the IMM 1295 Background Information section counts, including the medical questions 1a and 1b.
Only the security, immigration-history and criminal questions count; the medical questions do not trigger Schedule 1.
rules.source_quote: If you have answered “yes” to any of the background information questions on the application
rules.when_plain: Applies to every applicant who answers yes to any IMM 1295 background question.

rules.then: Open a separate application form set for this accompanying spouse/partner or child. The application type is not stated in the source.
rules.why_shown: New Delhi requires accompanying family members of all ages to submit their own application forms.
rules.source_quote: Accompanying spouse and children of all ages must submit their own application forms.
rules.when_plain: The spouse, partner or child will accompany the principal applicant to Canada.

rules.then: Add a study permit application (a separate combination) for this child, submitted at the same time as the principal's application.
rules.why_shown: The guide says children's study permits must be applied for at the same time.
rules.source_quote: You must apply for their study permit at the same time as your own.
rules.when_plain: An accompanying child plans to attend school in Canada.

rules.then: Add a separate work permit application for this family member.
rules.why_shown: Family members who want to work need their own work permits.
rules.source_quote: To work in Canada, your spouse or common-law partner and your dependent children must apply for their own work permits.
rules.when_plain: The spouse, partner or dependent child plans to work in Canada.

rules.then: The fee payment receipt must include the Open Work Permit Holder fee in addition to the processing fee.
rules.why_shown: Open work permit applicants pay an additional fee, stated in the guide.
rules.source_quote: If you are applying for an Open Work Permit, you must pay the $100 Open Work Permit Holder fee in addition to the Work Permit fee of $155.
rules.when_plain: The work permit type is an open work permit (code 'OWP' from the draft IMM 1295 code list; to confirm).

rules.then: The fee payment receipt must include the biometric fee, paid at the same time and in the same way as the processing fee.
rules.why_shown: The biometric fee must be paid together with the processing fee.
rules.source_quote: If you or your family members need to give biometric information, the biometric fee should be paid at the same time and in the same way as the processing fee.
rules.when_plain: The person must give biometric information.

rules.then: Task: after the biometric instruction letter arrives, book and attend biometrics collection promptly.
rules.why_shown: Processing starts only after biometrics are received.
rules.source_quote: You must provide your biometric data promptly after receiving the instruction letter inviting you to do so.
rules.when_plain: The person must give biometrics.

rules.then: Specialist to decide the number of paper photos required.
rules.why_shown: The sources disagree on the photo count.
readings: Two photos, as in IMM 5488 and Guide 5487.
One photo, as on the IRCC outside-Canada forms and documents page (possibly for online applications).
rules.source_quote: 1 photo meeting the visa photo specifications
rules.when_plain: Applies whenever paper photos are required (no biometrics).

rules.then: Specialist to decide the trigger for the proof of immigration status line.
rules.why_shown: The checklist and the guide word the trigger differently.
readings: Trigger is the country of residence differing from citizenship (IMM 5488).
Trigger is the country where the applicant is applying differing from citizenship (Guide 5487 and IRCC page), and the proof concerns status in that country.
rules.source_quote: If you are not a citizen of the country or territory where you are applying, you must send proof of your present immigration status in that country or territory.
rules.when_plain: The applicant is applying from a country of which they are not a citizen.

rules.then: Task: if the application is approved, send the original passport for the visa counterfoil when the visa office asks.
rules.why_shown: This depends on approval and visa office instructions, not on the initial package.
rules.source_quote: Note: If you require a temporary resident visa and your work permit application is approved, you will need to provide your original passport for the visa counterfoil to be issued.
rules.when_plain: The person requires a temporary resident visa.

rules.then: Specialist to decide when the marriage certificate applies.
rules.why_shown: 'If applicable' and 'may need' leave the trigger open.
readings: Required whenever the principal applicant is married.
Required only when the spouse accompanies the principal applicant (current draft).
rules.source_quote: You may need to provide a marriage certificate and birth certificates for any accompanying family members.
rules.when_plain: The principal applicant is married.

rules.then: Record the employer-provided offer of employment number in case.lmia_or_offer_number for entry on IMM 1295.
rules.why_shown: The offer number must appear on the application form for LMIA-exempt jobs.
rules.source_quote: If your employer is exempt from obtaining an LMIA from ESDC, your employer must provide you with the offer of employment number for inclusion in your work permit application form.
rules.when_plain: The job offer is LMIA-exempt.

rules.then: Add document: copy of the employment contract (provided by employer).
rules.why_shown: Without an offer submitted through the compliance regime, the contract evidences the job.
rules.source_quote: Note: If your employer is exempt from the Employer Compliance Regime, you must provide a copy of the employment contract.
rules.when_plain: The job is LMIA-exempt and the employer is exempt from the Employer Compliance Regime.

rules.then: Specialist to decide whether an employment contract is required for every LMIA-exempt job.
rules.why_shown: The sources conflict on the contract requirement.
readings: Contract is required for every LMIA-exempt job (IRCC page).
Contract is required only when the employer is exempt from the Employer Compliance Regime (IMM 5488 entry 8 note).
rules.source_quote: If your job is LMIA-exempt, your employer must give you:
rules.when_plain: The job offer is LMIA-exempt.

rules.then: Specialist to decide the CAQ trigger.
rules.why_shown: The sources word the CAQ condition differently.
readings: CAQ is needed for any LMIA-based job in Québec (IMM 5488).
CAQ is needed only for a paid LMIA job in Québec lasting more than 30 days (IRCC page). The guide adds that LMIA-exempt workers will 'usually' not need one.
rules.source_quote: a Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) (if you plan to work a paid job in Quebec for more than 30 days)
rules.when_plain: The intended work location is in Québec.

rules.then: Add document: copy of the IRCC acknowledgment letter confirming receipt of the permanent residence application before the nomination expired.
rules.why_shown: An expired nomination must be backed by proof that the PR application was received in time.
rules.source_quote: If your nomination certificate has expired, you must include a copy of the acknowledgment letter confirming that IRCC received your application for permanent residence before the nomination expired.
rules.when_plain: The applicant is a provincial nominee whose nomination certificate has expired by the application date.

rules.then: Add document: proof of language proficiency (language test results).
rules.why_shown: PGWP applications submitted on or after 1 November 2024 need language test results.
rules.source_quote: Proof of language proficiency for all applications submitted on or after November 1, 2024
rules.when_plain: PGWP application submitted on or after 1 November 2024, unless the applicant is a flight school graduate (the exception is from Guide 5487: 'The only exception to language requirement is flight school graduates.').

rules.then: On IMM 1295 'Details of intended work in Canada', set question 1 to 'Open Work Permit' and question 2a (name of employer) to 'Post Graduate Work Permit'.
rules.why_shown: The guide gives fixed entries for PGWP applicants applying from outside Canada.
rules.source_quote: Question 1: Choose “Open Work Permit”
rules.when_plain: The application is for a post-graduation work permit.

rules.then: Specialist to decide whether proof of an eligible field of study is a requirement line for this combination.
rules.why_shown: The guide marks the field of study as 'if applicable' without saying when it applies.
readings: Proof of eligible field of study is required for PGWP applicants whose program is subject to a field-of-study requirement (that criterion is not stated in the inputs).
It is an online-account upload outside the document package and does not need a requirement line.
rules.source_quote: You must upload your eligible field of study (if applicable) in the “Client Information” section of your account.
rules.when_plain: The application is for a post-graduation work permit.

rules.then: For any employment document slot requested in the portal, upload a blank document marked 'Not applicable'.
rules.why_shown: Open work permit applicants have no employer documents.
rules.source_quote: If you’re applying for an open work permit and you’re asked to submit any employment documents, upload a blank document with the words “Not applicable”.
rules.when_plain: The application is for an open work permit.

rules.then: In place of the licence or certification, upload a blank sheet marked 'Not applicable'.
rules.why_shown: The IRCC page asks for a placeholder when the job is not regulated.
rules.source_quote: Upload a blank sheet of paper with “Not applicable” written on it if your job doesn’t require a license or certification
rules.when_plain: Employer-specific work permit for a job that does not require a licence or certification.

rules.then: Specialist to decide who may translate for New Delhi submissions.
rules.why_shown: The guide allows a fluent non-certified translator with an affidavit; New Delhi asks for a certified translation.
readings: Any fluent person (not the applicant or family) may translate, with an affidavit if not a Canadian certified translator (Guide 5487).
Only a certified translation is accepted for New Delhi, so the non-certified-translator route does not apply (IMM 5905).
rules.source_quote: a person who is fluent in both languages (English or French, and the unofficial language); or
rules.when_plain: A submitted document is not in English or French.

rules.then: The translator must not be the applicant or a member of the applicant's family; warn the client.
rules.why_shown: Translations by applicants or relatives are not accepted.
rules.source_quote: Translations must not be done by the applicants themselves nor by members of the applicant’s family.
rules.when_plain: A submitted document is not in English or French.

rules.then: Task: specialist checks whether each applicant needs a medical exam (duration of stay, residence in listed countries, occupation). The country lists are not in the inputs.
rules.why_shown: The medical requirement depends on facts and lists outside these sources.
rules.source_quote: You and your family members may need a medical exam to come to Canada.
rules.when_plain: Every case.

rules.then: A medical exam is required. Show the upfront medical option and the proof-of-medical document line.
rules.why_shown: Health services, child care and primary or secondary education jobs need a medical exam before the permit is issued.
rules.source_quote: If you want to work in health services, child care, primary or secondary education, you will need a medical exam and a satisfactory medical assessment before we can issue you a work permit.
rules.when_plain: The intended work is in health services, child care, or primary or secondary education.

rules.then: Task: if the officer asks, obtain police clearance certificates.
rules.why_shown: This depends on an officer's request.
rules.source_quote: you may be asked to give us a Police Clearance Certificate

sections.title: Application details
sections.meaning: Case-level facts about the application itself: type, dates, office, numbers and service language.

sections.title: Personal details

sections.title: Languages
sections.meaning: Each person's native language and ability in English and French.

sections.title: Travel and identity documents

sections.title: Contact details

sections.title: Residence and immigration status

sections.title: Spouse or partner relationship

sections.title: Family members

sections.title: Intended work in Canada

sections.title: Education history
sections.meaning: Periods of post-secondary education, one row per period.

sections.title: Employment and activity history
sections.meaning: Periods of occupation or activity, one row per period.

sections.title: Medical background
sections.meaning: Background answers about tuberculosis and disorders requiring health or social services.

sections.title: Background declarations
sections.meaning: Yes/no background answers and their details on immigration history, criminality, military service, organisations, ill treatment and government positions.

sections.title: Service, membership and government position history

sections.title: Travel history
sections.meaning: Rows describing each trip the person took to other countries.

sections.title: Representative and authorizations
sections.meaning: The firm's representative, the use-of-representative filing, and any authority to release information.

sections.title: Processing requirements
sections.meaning: Per-person processing facts such as fees, biometrics, visa need and medical exam completion.

sections.title: Submitted documents
sections.meaning: Facts about each submitted document, such as its language and translation.

checks.applies_to: Passport or travel document of each applicant
checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Get a renewed passport or travel document and verify it. For a Venezuelan passport, refer to the specialist; special rules apply.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the printed passport expiry date is before the application date. Expiry only warns, never blocks.

checks.applies_to: Passport information page of each applicant
checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Verify the passport information page and record the missing passport number, issue or expiry date, name, date or place of birth.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when any fact that the passport information page must show is missing from the verified record: number, issue date, expiry date, name, date of birth or place of birth.

checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Tell the client the passport expires within 90 days of the application date and discuss renewal before submission.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the passport expires within 90 days after the application date (default 90-day window).

checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Urgently raise passport renewal with the client; the passport expires within 30 days of the application date.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the passport expires within 30 days after the application date (default 30-day window).

checks.applies_to: National identity document of each applicant
checks.user_action: Tell the client the national identity document expires within 90 days and ask whether a renewed document will be available.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the national identity document expires within 90 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: National identity document of each applicant
checks.user_action: Urgently raise renewal of the national identity document with the client.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the national identity document expires within 30 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: US permanent resident card of each applicant
checks.user_action: Tell the client the US permanent resident card expires within 90 days and ask about renewal.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for a US lawful permanent resident whose card expires within 90 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: US permanent resident card of each applicant
checks.user_action: Urgently raise renewal of the US permanent resident card with the client.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for a US lawful permanent resident whose card expires within 30 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: Immigration status in the current country of residence
checks.source_quote: Proof of current immigration status: If your country or territory of residence differs from the citizenship listed on your passport, you must provide proof of legal status in your country or territory of residence.
checks.user_action: Tell the client their status in the country of residence ends within 90 days; ask for proof of renewal or extension.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the end date of the current residence status falls within 90 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: Immigration status in the current country of residence
checks.source_quote: Proof of current immigration status: If your country or territory of residence differs from the citizenship listed on your passport, you must provide proof of legal status in your country or territory of residence.
checks.user_action: Urgently ask for proof of renewed status in the country of residence.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the end date of the current residence status falls within 30 days after the application date.

checks.applies_to: Provincial nomination certificate of the principal applicant
checks.source_quote: If your nomination certificate has expired, you must include a copy of the acknowledgment letter confirming that IRCC received your application for permanent residence before the nomination expired.
checks.user_action: Obtain and attach the IRCC acknowledgment letter showing the permanent residence application was received before the nomination expired.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a provincial nominee's nomination certificate has expired by the application date.

checks.applies_to: Provincial nomination certificate of the principal applicant
checks.source_quote: If your nomination certificate has expired, you must include a copy of the acknowledgment letter confirming that IRCC received your application for permanent residence before the nomination expired.
checks.user_action: Warn staff the nomination expires within 90 days; check whether the acknowledgment letter will be needed.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the nomination certificate expires within 90 days after the application date.

checks.source_quote: Proof of current immigration status: If your country or territory of residence differs from the citizenship listed on your passport, you must provide proof of legal status in your country or territory of residence.
checks.user_action: Confirm the status held in the country of residence; record a second citizenship if one exists, or correct the status and collect proof of legal status.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the current residence status is 'Citizen' (draft code 01, to confirm) although the country of residence differs from the passport citizenship.

checks.applies_to: Family name and given names of each applicant
checks.source_quote: Fill out all sections. If a section does not apply to you, write “Not Applicable” or “NA”. Do not do this for the name fields (your last name and given names).
checks.user_action: Remove 'NA' or 'Not Applicable' from the name fields and follow the IMM 1295 name instructions (for example a person with one name only).
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the family name or given names are recorded as 'NA' or 'Not Applicable'.

checks.applies_to: IMM 1295, IMM 5707, IMM 5409, IMM 5476, IMM 5475 and IMM 5257 Schedule 1 when included
checks.source_quote: FORMS LIST: The following IRCC forms must be completed, signed and dated.
checks.user_action: Confirm every included form has been signed and dated by the right person (or the parent or legal guardian for a person under 18) before submission.
checks.gap_reason: No canonical field records whether a signature and signing date have been placed; signatures are never filled by the system.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when any included form lacks its signature or signing date.

checks.source_quote: Note: If this application form is completed on a computer it must be validated to generate a barcode page.
checks.user_action: Open the rendered IMM 1295, press Validate, and confirm the barcode page is generated and placed on top of the application.
checks.gap_reason: The form's validation flag is a form helper, not a canonical fact; no field records that the form was validated.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the computer-completed IMM 1295 has not been validated and has no barcode page.

checks.applies_to: Offer of employment number for an LMIA-exempt job
checks.source_quote: If your employer is exempt from obtaining an LMIA from ESDC, your employer must provide you with the offer of employment number for inclusion in your work permit application form.
checks.user_action: Obtain the offer of employment number from the employer and record it.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the job is LMIA-exempt, the employer is not marked exempt from the Employer Compliance Regime, and no offer of employment number is recorded.

checks.applies_to: Offer of employment number for an LMIA-exempt job
checks.source_quote: The offer of employment number starts with the letter “A” and is followed by seven numbers.
checks.user_action: Check the recorded offer number against the employer's notice: the letter A followed by seven digits.
checks.gap_reason: The condition language has no pattern or text-length operator, so the 'A plus seven digits' format cannot be tested.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when an LMIA-exempt offer number does not start with 'A' followed by exactly seven digits.

checks.applies_to: LMIA number for an LMIA-based job
checks.source_quote: Your employer should give you a copy of this letter to include with your application for a work permit.
checks.user_action: Obtain the LMIA letter from the employer and record the LMIA number.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the employer obtained an LMIA but no LMIA number is recorded.

checks.source_quote: issued based on a labour market impact assessment (LMIA) from Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), or an offer of employment from an LMIA-exempt employer.
checks.user_action: Confirm with the employer papers whether the job is LMIA-based or LMIA-exempt, and correct one of the two facts.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the case is marked both as having an LMIA and as LMIA-exempt.

checks.source_quote: usually valid only for a specific employer, job and length of time;
checks.user_action: Correct either the IMM 1295 work permit type or the employer-specific classification.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the IMM 1295 type is open work permit (draft code OWP, to confirm) but the case is classified as employer-specific.

checks.applies_to: IMM 1295 details of intended work for a post-graduation work permit
checks.user_action: Set the IMM 1295 work permit type to Open Work Permit.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a post-graduation work permit application does not have the open work permit type (draft code OWP, to confirm).

checks.applies_to: IMM 1295 question 2a for a post-graduation work permit
checks.source_quote: Question 2a (Name of employer): Write “Post Graduate Work Permit”
checks.user_action: Enter 'Post Graduate Work Permit' as the employer name on IMM 1295.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a post-graduation work permit application's IMM 1295 employer name (the prospective-employer instance of organisation.name) is not 'Post Graduate Work Permit'.

checks.source_quote: You have up to 180 days after you receive confirmation from your school that you have completed
checks.user_action: Record the date the school confirmed completion and refer timing questions to the specialist.
checks.gap_reason: No canonical field holds the date the school confirmed program completion, so days elapsed to the application date cannot be calculated.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the application date is more than 180 days after the school's completion confirmation.

checks.applies_to: Language proof for a post-graduation work permit
checks.source_quote: Proof of language proficiency for all applications submitted on or after November 1, 2024
checks.user_action: Ask the client for language test results, or confirm with the specialist whether the flight school exception applies.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for a post-graduation work permit applied for on or after 1 November 2024 where the applicant says no language test was taken and is not a flight school graduate.

checks.applies_to: Medical exam for intended work in health services, child care or primary or secondary education
checks.source_quote: If you want to work in health services, child care, primary or secondary education, you will need a medical exam and a satisfactory medical assessment before we can issue you a work permit.
checks.user_action: Tell the client a medical exam will be needed; offer the upfront exam with a panel physician and collect its proof if done.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the intended work requires a medical exam and no upfront medical exam is recorded.

checks.applies_to: Medical exam triggered by stay length and residence in listed countries
checks.source_quote: If you plan to work, visit or study in Canada for more than six months:
checks.user_action: Specialist decides whether each applicant needs a medical exam; the country list is not in the sources.
checks.gap_reason: The list of countries or territories that trigger a medical exam is not in the inputs, so the condition cannot be written.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the stay exceeds six months and the person lived six or more months in a row in a listed country in the year before entry.

checks.applies_to: Common-law relationship of the principal applicant
checks.source_quote: done so continuously for a period of at least one year.
checks.user_action: Refer to the specialist: confirm the cohabitation start date, or whether an exception (legal restrictions or separation beyond the couple's control) applies.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the marital status is common-law (placeholder code) but continuous cohabitation is less than one whole year at the application date.

checks.applies_to: Common-law start date on IMM 1295 against cohabitation start on IMM 5409
checks.source_quote: b) (If you are married or in a common-law relationship) Provide the date on which you were married or entered into the c
checks.user_action: Ask the client which date is correct and make the two dates agree, or record why they differ.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for a common-law couple when the date the relationship began (IMM 1295) differs from the date continuous cohabitation began (IMM 5409).

checks.source_quote: If none of the above sections applies, what other documentary evidence do you have that would indicate your relationship as common-law partners?
checks.user_action: Ask the couple for other documentary evidence of the relationship and record it.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for a common-law couple when every IMM 5409 evidence answer readable for the principal is 'no' and no other evidence is described. The partner's own life-insurance answer is on the partner's record and is not read here.

checks.source_quote: This can be shown with evidence that the couple share the same home
checks.user_action: If the partners' addresses differ, ask the couple to explain (for example separation beyond their control) and refer to the specialist.
checks.gap_reason: The condition language reads one subject's facts and compares a field to a fixed value; it cannot compare the principal's address with the partner's address.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when a common-law partner's present address (IMM 5707) differs from the principal's residential address.

checks.source_quote: Proxy, telephone, fax, internet and similar forms of marriage where one or both parties were not
checks.user_action: Ask whether both spouses were physically present at the ceremony; if not, refer to the specialist.
checks.gap_reason: The IMM 5707 'physically present at the marriage ceremony' answers have no canonical field.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when a married applicant or spouse was not physically present at the marriage ceremony.

checks.applies_to: Marital status against the spouse or partner record
checks.user_action: Correct the marital status or remove the spouse or partner record so IMM 1295 and IMM 5707 agree.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a spouse or partner record exists but the principal's marital status is neither married nor common-law (placeholder codes).

checks.applies_to: Marital status against the spouse or partner record
checks.user_action: Add the spouse or partner record so the IMM 1295 spouse name and IMM 5707 spouse block can be completed.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the principal is married or common-law (placeholder codes) but no spouse or partner record exists.

checks.applies_to: Relationship stated on the principal's and the spouse's records
checks.user_action: Make the principal's and the spouse's marital status agree on IMM 1295, IMM 5707 and the spouse's own forms.
checks.gap_reason: The condition language reads one subject's facts at a time; it cannot compare the principal's marital status with the spouse's.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the spouse or partner's marital status does not match the principal's (for example the principal married, the spouse single).

checks.applies_to: Names of each person across IMM 1295, IMM 5707, IMM 5409, IMM 5476, IMM 5475 and Schedule 1
checks.source_quote: (full name of declarant as shown on passport/travel document)
checks.user_action: Compare the IMM 5409 full name with the passport family and given names and correct any difference.
checks.gap_reason: The full name is a separate field; checking it against family name plus given names needs text composition and field-to-field comparison, which the condition language lacks.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when a person's full name on IMM 5409 does not equal their passport family and given names.

checks.applies_to: Facts recorded under two ids by different forms
checks.source_quote: The information on your application may be verified.
checks.user_action: Compare each pair and correct the value that differs; reviewers may merge the ids.
checks.gap_reason: Equality between two fields is not expressible; leaves compare a field only to a fixed value.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when UCI, country of birth or e-mail differs between the two ids holding the same fact for one person.

checks.source_quote: If working in the province of Québec with an LMIA, provide evidence of a valid Québec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ)
checks.user_action: Make the province on IMM 1295 match the province recorded for the job, since it decides whether CAQ evidence is needed.
checks.gap_reason: Comparing the province part of an address field with another field is not expressible.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the province in the IMM 1295 work location differs from the recorded province of intended work.

checks.applies_to: Military service answer on IMM 1295 and Schedule 1
checks.source_quote: Question 4 Military Service. Did you serve in any military, militia, or civil defence unit or serve in a security organization or police force (including non obligatory national service, reserve or volunteer units)?
checks.user_action: Ask the applicant to confirm the answer and make IMM 1295 and Schedule 1 agree.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the military service answer on IMM 1295 and on Schedule 1 differ.

checks.source_quote: c) If you answered "yes" to question 1a) or 1b), please provide details and the name of the family member (if applicable).
checks.user_action: Collect the details (and the family member's name if applicable) from the applicant.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a medical background question is answered yes but no details are recorded.

checks.source_quote: d) If you answered “yes” to question 2a), 2b), or 2c) please provide details.
checks.user_action: Collect the details of the status violation or refusal from the applicant. Question 2c is not yet covered (no field).
checks.condition_plain: Fires when question 2a or 2b is answered yes but no details are recorded.

checks.source_quote: b) If you answered “yes” to question 3a) above, please provide details.
checks.user_action: Collect the criminal history details from the applicant.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the criminal history question is answered yes but no details are recorded.

checks.source_quote: b) If you answered yes to question 4a), please provide dates of service and countries or territories where you served.
checks.user_action: Collect the dates and countries of service from the applicant.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when military service is answered yes but no dates and countries of service are recorded.

checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Re-read the passport information page and correct the issue or expiry date.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the passport expiry date is on or before its issue date.

checks.applies_to: Passport issue date against date of birth
checks.source_quote: A photocopy of the information page of your valid passport or travel document which includes:the passport number;the issuance and expiry dates;your photo, name, date and place of birth.
checks.user_action: Re-read the passport and correct the date of birth or issue date.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the passport issue date is before the person's date of birth.

checks.applies_to: Duration of expected employment on IMM 1295
checks.user_action: Check the offer of employment or LMIA and correct the start or end date.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the expected employment end date is on or before the start date.

checks.user_action: Ask the employer for an updated start date and record it.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the expected employment start date is before the application date.

checks.applies_to: Rows of employment, education, residence status and travel history
checks.user_action: Correct the row whose end date is before its start date.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when any history row (activity, education, residence status or trip) ends before it starts.

checks.user_action: Ask what the person did in the missing period (for example not working or studying) and record it as a history row; the warning then clears.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when there is at least one uncovered month between consecutive activity rows. A gap is a warning, not a stop.

checks.source_quote: If your documents are in a language other than English or French, you must include a certified
checks.user_action: Obtain a certified English or French translation and attach it with the original-language document.
checks.condition_plain: Fires for each document recorded as not in English or French, to remind staff a certified translation must accompany it.

checks.applies_to: Translations by a translator who is not a Canadian certified translator
checks.source_quote: If the translation isn’t done by a Canadian certified translator, the person who completed the translation must provide an affidavit swearing to their language proficiency and the accuracy of the translation.
checks.user_action: Specialist decides whether New Delhi accepts this translation; if so, attach the translator's affidavit.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a translated document's translator is not a Canadian certified translator. Pending: New Delhi asks for a certified translation, which may exclude this route.

checks.source_quote: Translations must not be done by the applicants themselves nor by members of the applicant’s family.
checks.user_action: Confirm the translator is neither the applicant nor a family member; if so, get a new translation.
checks.gap_reason: No canonical field records who the translator is or their relationship to the applicant.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when a translation was done by the applicant or a family member.

checks.applies_to: Reference letters for work experience (New Delhi)
checks.source_quote: Letters of reference must outline the duration and specific nature of your
checks.user_action: Check each reference letter shows the duration, specific duties, and a contact name, address and phone number; ask for a corrected letter if not.
checks.gap_reason: No canonical fields record the contents of a reference letter.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when a reference letter lacks duration, specific duties or contact details.

checks.source_quote: If you are applying for an Open Work Permit, you must pay the $100 Open Work Permit Holder fee in addition to the Work Permit fee of $155.
checks.user_action: Compare the receipt amount with the processing, open work permit holder and biometric fees that apply.
checks.gap_reason: No canonical field holds the amount paid on the receipt, and the expected total needs a fee calculation across people.
checks.condition_plain: Should fire when the amount on the payment receipt does not cover the applicable fees.

checks.source_quote: c) In which language are you most at ease?
checks.user_action: Confirm the answers with the applicant and correct one if needed.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when the person can communicate only in English but is most at ease in French, or only in French but most at ease in English (draft codes, to confirm).

checks.source_quote: Complete this form only if you are using the services of an authorized representative
checks.user_action: Add the representative's membership number to their profile.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a paid representative is used but no membership number is recorded in the representative's profile.

checks.applies_to: Venezuelan passport issued on or after 7 June 2019
checks.source_quote: If your passport is expired, it can’t be used to apply for temporary residence.
checks.user_action: Refer to the specialist; the client may need a new passport or other travel document. Do not decide for the client.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a Venezuelan passport (country value to map to the canonical code) issued on or after 7 June 2019 has expired by the application date.

checks.source_quote: If it’s been more than 5 years since the printed expiry date, your passport is considered expired.
checks.user_action: Specialist confirms the 5-year boundary and reviews any exceptional-situation letter of explanation.
checks.condition_plain: Fires when a Venezuelan passport issued before 7 June 2019 has been expired for 5 whole years or more. Pending: the guide says both '5 years or more' and 'more than 5 years'.
